item.title: 🔒 Travelers deploying AI agents for auto claims
item.description: The AI Claim Assistant will be expanded to additional lines of business and a broader set of claim interactions over time.

item.title: 🔒 CT renews Anthem, Quantum Health contracts for state employee health plan
item.description: Connecticut will continue using Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield to administer the state employee health plan following a competitive bidding process.

item.title: 🔒 FanDuel Sports Network parent company to close CT facility, impacting 44 workers
item.description: Main Street Sports Group LLC plans to permanently close its Southport facility, a move that will affect 44 workers in Connecticut.

item.title: London insurtech announces plans to open U.S. operations in Hartford
item.description: DQPro, a London-based insurance technology firm, plans to establish U.S. operations in Hartford.

item.title: Mass. refrigerated trucking company wants to build Manchester terminal facility
item.description: A public hearing on a proposal by Singh Realty Group LLC to build a truck terminal facility for Apache Trucking at 51 Commerce Road in Manchester’s Buckland Industrial Park continues tonight before the Planning and Zoning Commission, amid unresolved questions about wetlands.

item.title: 🔒 Major industrial landlord sells 640K-sq.-ft. CT portfolio near Bradley International Airport
item.description: Indus Realty Trust, long a major force in industrial development north of Hartford, has recently sold a roughly 641,000-square-foot portfolio of industrial buildings in East Granby, Windsor and Bloomfield

item.title: 3 years after opening its Hartford office, Talcott Financial Group announces 101 layoffs
item.description: Talcott Resolution Life Inc., a subsidiary of international life insurer Talcott Financial Group, plans to lay off more than 100 employees this spring as it closes certain units at its downtown Hartford offices.
